observed_source_paths.finding: External LHE strategy magnitude 4 obtains XWGTUP from the official reader and converts pb to internal mb once.
Magnitude 4 uses the external sigma as the nominal process weight, followed by the separate bias-selection factor.
The nominal Info weight is stored in pb for external strategies plus/minus 4.
Resonance decays run after nominal process weight assignment; this inspected conditional decay path does not multiply the nominal external weight by the Higgs branching fraction.
Enabled-channel widths are summed and decay-channel selection samples relative to that enabled-channel sum. Forcing one supported channel changes its conditional sampling probability.

The supported LesHouches quark-mass policy may change initially massless heavy-quark momenta and masses after exact external-reader input validation. This is recorded model behavior, not source or detector momentum repair.

required_runtime_closure_before_model_br: Actual full source validated with IDWTUP=-4 and denominator 1000.
Every actual Info weight divided by original nonzero XWGTUP agrees with the measured nominal-inclusion convention; zero weights handled explicitly.
Every actual HepMC converter nominal weight agrees with the corresponding Info weight.
Actual initialized inclusive and forced Higgs tables share the same positive total/partial widths and inclusive H-to-gamma-gamma model BR.
Actual forced Higgs conditional probability is one; actual H-origin two-photon birth verified in every shower/HepMC record.
Only the missing factor is applied once to the raw signed source contribution in a separate MODEL_BR_ONLY quantity.
scope_limits: Source inspection alone does not establish event-weight closure.
MODEL_BR_ONLY is not an official calibrated background normalization.
B04 source-included Z-to-bb factor must never be multiplied again.
B05 inclusive supported top/W model channels remain inclusive; no exclusive top/W factor or HH factor of two is applied.
Pythia fallback production-decay spin correlations are not validated.
